title: Environment configuration validation

requirements.text: Configuration is validated once at startup and the process refuses to start when it is invalid
Values parse strictly into typed fields (booleans, integers, URLs, enums) with defaults; malformed values are rejected
Every missing or invalid key is reported together, by key name
Secret values never appear in errors, logs, serialization or inspection
The validated configuration is a frozen typed object
A .env.example listing every variable is generated from the same schema
Only variables explicitly marked public can reach a browser bundle; server secrets cannot

evidence.name: aggregates every problem by key in one ConfigError
converts typed values and parses each field kind
booleans accept true/false/1/0/yes/no/on/off case-insensitively and reject others
numbers reject hex, empty-ish, and non-integer input
aggregates every problem by key in one ConfigError
secret values never appear in errors, JSON, toString, inspection, describe, or examples
parses a valid source with defaults and returns a frozen object
renders a .env.example and a structured description

implementations.notes: Throws ConfigError on invalid input; calling it at startup is the app's wiring

notes: client-exposure is uncovered: env-config has no public/server split for browser bundles.
